intent: The circle that ends an AvatarGroup's stack and stands for the members not shown.
typical_uses: A "+N" count after the last visible avatar of a group

dont_use_when.situation: A count outside a stack of avatars, such as an unread number or a tag

invariants.text: The count takes no size prop: its circle is the default avatar size, and becomes the `sm` or `lg` size when its group has a direct Avatar child of that size (`lg` when both are present); its label stays at one text size throughout, and only an svg inside it grows at `lg`.
`tone` and `variant` pick one of the twelve fill cells avatar.module.css shares with AvatarFallback, so a count chip and a fallback given the same pair paint the same colors.

tone.states: tone is one of neutral, accent, info, success, warning or danger, and neutral when omitted
tone.because: avatar.tsx builds this cva axis from the shared `fillAxes` object, which the extractor does not follow, so the prop reaches the contract through its VariantProps type, a string union with `null` and `undefined`, and the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

variant.states: variant is solid or soft, and soft when omitted
variant.because: avatar.tsx builds this cva axis from the shared `fillAxes` object, which the extractor does not follow, so the prop reaches the contract through its VariantProps type, a string union with `null` and `undefined`, and the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

good.title: A count matching a group of small avatars
A count filled to match toned members

bad.title: A size prop guessed from Avatar
bad.why: AvatarGroupCount declares no `size`; the count already takes the small size from the `sm` Avatar beside it in the same group.
